evidence.note: User recalls the 2017 entry as likely the Half Marathon. The official Online Race Results archive confirms that the April 22, 2017 event offered Marathon, Half Marathon, and 10K races, but current search indexing has not produced an Alex Ford participant record in any distance. Do not publish a distance or finish time as verified until the participant result is recovered.
User explicitly confirms that the Snow Mountain Ranch 1st Place Age Class award belongs to the Sunday 25K Classic leg of the Ranch Hand weekend.

Online Race Results lists the COLDERBolder 5K on December 2, 2023, matching the Strava recording. A current BOLDERBoulder historical archive page labels the 2023 COLDERBolder as December 9. Preserve December 2 in the race record while retaining this discrepancy for source reconciliation.
